search_summary: Searches show demand clustered on MAS licensing routes, RBC2 mechanics and AML/CFT, with a fresh 20 Nov 2026 news item on the amendment act extending MAS's mandate to proliferation financing under the Insurance Act (new penalty regime). Competitor results are dominated by law-firm practice pages and job postings, leaving thin dedicated content on foreign reinsurer authorisation, overseas broker approval, PCR/MCR mechanics, ORSA stress testing and embedded value M&A work. MAS compliance toolkits were refreshed in June 2026 and the PCC consultation closed Aug 2026, supporting practical, how-to content.
